meta.title: About Puntr | A better standard for sports predictions
meta.description: Meet Puntr: a South African sports prediction community built around transparent records, consistent grading and shared sporting knowledge.
meta.ogTitle: About Puntr | Sports knowledge, on the record

hero.body: Puntr is a <1>community-first sports platform</1> for South African fans who want more than big claims and screenshots. Publish picks before kick-off, see them locked and automatically graded, and build a public record that shows the full picture. <1>AI-powered insights</1> are part of the platform’s wider roadmap.

why.p1: Sport is full of opinions. Puntr gives those opinions a consistent way to be tested: every pick is timestamped before kick-off, locked and graded against the result.
why.p2: A winning screenshot tells only part of the story. Puntr keeps wins and losses together, with performance context, so the community can judge a record on its merits.
